name: PLANNING COMMISSION
agenda_text:
PLANNING COMMISSION
PLANNING COMMISSION
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday JUNE 8, 2017
07:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. Call to Order
2. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
3. Administration of Oath
4. Roll Call: Chair Nemeth Vice Chair Eneix
Commissioner Avery, French, and Ward
5. Review of Agenda
6. Motion to Waive Full Reading of all Resolutions on the Agenda for this Meeting
7. Public Comments on Consent Calendar Items and any Items not on the Agenda
8. Consent Calendar Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of May 11, 2017
Minutes
9. Public Hearings
9A. Tentative Tract Map (TTM) 66687 Time Extension (TE) No. 2, Site Plan Review (SPR) 3-06-1 Time Extension (TE) No. 2, General Plan Amendment 17-001, and Zone Change 17-016
Beazer Homes Holdings Corporation, Applicant
Requests for the following items: a) a request for a three-year time extension to develop a 48 condominium unit project; b) a request to amend the General Plan Land Use Designation on approximately 18,000 square feet from OC (Office Commercial) to MR (Medium Residential); and c) a request to change the Zone Designation on approximately 18,000 square feet from C-2 (Office Commercial) to R-2 (Medium Residential) located east of Fairway Drive, approximately 565 feet north of Rancho Vista Boulevard.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission continue this item to the Planning Commission meeting of July 13, 2017, due to the project site sign posting requirements not being met. Victor Mendez, Assistant Planner
9A
9B. Tentative Tract Map 61894 Time Extension
New Anaverde, LLC, Applicant
(Continued from the April 13, 2017 Planning Commission Meeting)
A request for the first three-year time extension for the subdivision of approximately 461 acres into 334 single-family residential lots, three detention basin lots, and 29 open space lots south of Avenue S and west of Parkwood Drive within the Anaverde Development.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-016 recommending that the City Council approve Tentative Tract Map 61894 Time Extension No. 1; and recommend that the City Council find that the project will not result in any changes to the Mitigated Negative Declaration and Mitigation Monitoring Plan adopted for TTM 61894 on March 14, 2005. Carlene Saxton, Senior Planner
9B
9C. Tentative Tract Map 69651 Time Extension
Pacific Communities Builder, Inc., Applicant
A request for the first three-year time extension to subdivide approximately 20 acres into 71 single-family residential lots and two detention basin lots located at the southeast corner of Palmdale Boulevard and 61st Street East.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-021 approving TTM 69651 TE No. 1 and find that the project will not result in any changes to the Mitigated Negative Declaration adopted for the project. Carlene Saxton, Senior Planner
9C
9D. Specific Plan Amendment (SPA) 17-002
City of Palmdale, Applicant
A request to amend the Palmdale Trade and Commerce Center Specific Plan by adding an additional Zone Designation of C (Commercial) and by reclassifying certain real property from PF (Public Facility) zone district to C (Commercial) on approximately four acres located approximately 800 feet northwest of Technology Drive, east of State Route 14.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-023 recommending that the City Council approve Specific Plan Amendment (SPA) 17-002 and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Carlene Saxton, Senior Planner
9D
Edited Specific Plan
9E. Conditional Use Permit (CUP) 17-004
Mr. Francisco Negrete, Applicant
A request to establish a Type 47 Alcoholic Beverage Control license within a bona fide restaurant (Tortas Ahogadas Las Originales) located at 641 West Palmdale Boulevard, Suite B.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-022 approving alcoholic beverage sales within a bona fide restaurant (Tortas Ahogadas Las Originales), and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. It is also recommended that the Planning Commission review the data and make a determination as to whether public convenience or necessity will be served by the use. Carlene Saxton, Senior Planner
9E
10. Staff Communications Development Updates
Rob Bruce, Planning Manager
11. Planning Commission Communications
12. Adjournment to the regular Planning Commission Meeting of Thursday, July 13, 2017, at 7:00 p.m., in the City of Palmdale City Hall Council Chamber
